Questions

Is it really free?

Yes. There are no ads, no subscription and no paid extras. Coins in the shop are earned by focusing, never bought.

Do I need to install anything?

No. Pomodorolist runs in your browser on phones, tablets and computers. You can add it to your home screen from your browser’s menu if you like.

What data is stored?

Your username (no email address), and in your own account: your sessions, settings, notes, reminders and progress. Passwords are handled by Firebase Authentication and are never visible to anyone. Friends only see what you allow in Settings. There are no ads and no tracking or analytics.

Can I use it without an account?

Yes. Choose “Continue without an account” and everything is saved on this device only. You won’t get sync, friends or leaderboards, and you can create an account later and move your sessions into it.

What if I forget my password?

There’s no password reset yet, because accounts don’t use an email address. Use a password manager or pick a password you’ll remember. If you get stuck, email siverieg.p@gmail.com.

      Reminders

      Web reminders only fire while Pomodorolist is open — a background tab is fine, a closed tab or a locked phone is not. Use the calendar button on a reminder to add it to your phone’s calendar, which can remind you even when the app is closed.

      Appearance

      True Minimalist
      Just the timer, your plans and stats — no levels, coins, shop, quests, badges or rewards. Nothing is deleted; switch back anytime.
      Keep Pomeo in True Minimalist
      He stays on the Timer but talks less
      Theme
      Light, dark or follow your device
      Glossed Interface
      Frosted, translucent cards over soft colour. Lite (the default) is gentle and easy on older phones; Full adds more blur and shine. Saved on this device.
      Focus atmosphere
      A slow background glow on the Timer: calmer and deeper as a focus block goes on, lighter during breaks
      Festive decorations
      During monthly questlines: a small seasonal touch in the header, Pomeo in costume, event loading quotes and a banner on the Timer
      Time-of-day background
      A very faint sky that follows your clock: sunrise, day, sunset and a few stars at night. No location or weather data is used.
      Rain mood
      Gentle rain over the sky. Calm with Animations off.
      Ripening ring
      The timer ring ripens from green to tomato red during a focus block. Off: your theme colour.
      Animations
      Full, reduced (simple fades) or off. Saved on this device.

      Pomodorolist

      A calm focus timer with friends, quests and a tomato named Pomeo.

      Version

      What’s new

        Privacy

        • Your sessions, settings and notes are stored in your own account (or only on this device if you don’t log in).
        • Friends only see what you allow in Settings → Friends & privacy: your badge, streak, focus minutes and, if you choose, session names.
        • No ads and no tracking. Sounds, animations, the inbox and tips are saved on this device only. Focus check-ins stay in your own account.

        Credits

        • Designed and built by siverieg.
        • Cloud sync by Firebase. Icons in the style of Lucide. Every sound is generated live with the Web Audio API.
